Wu, M., McCormack, K., Scott, W.A., Smith, A., Zhang, J., Stock, J.H. (2025). Policy Options to Achieve US Sustainable Aviation Fuel Targets. NBER Working Paper 34326. National Bureau of Economic Research, Cambridge, MA.

Policy-market model of US SAF; not peer reviewed. Loaded: the Table 4 feedstock conversion rates (and the text's ethanol-per-gallon and corn-per-gallon figures) as input flows on the HEFA, transesterification, alcohol-to-jet and dry-mill archetypes. NOT loaded: the fixed non-feedstock costs per gallon (kept in other-values: they exclude feedstock and would mix with full production costs), policy, elasticity and demand tables, life-cycle CIs. Traps: (1) Table 4 calls the biodiesel route HEFA; (2) the corn conversion rates in Table 4 are two-thirds of the true need (DDGS credit) - the plant flow is from the text; (3) conversion rates are reprinted from other sources (Iowa State, Gerveni and Irwin, Eggert, AEI) that are not held, so they are credited to Wu.
